# Parley v0.1.7

This beta expands supervised pane-to-pane collaboration and gives workspaces a
clearer folder model. Distinct agent panes can now collaborate even when they
use the same vendor, while workspace identity no longer changes when the
starting folder for future panes changes.

## Agent collaboration

- Protocol v8 permits `relay`, `ask`, `ask-many`, delegated work, reviewed
  context and supervised recipes between any two distinct agent panes.
- Same-vendor routes are supported, including Copilot panes running different
  models. Self-targeting, ambiguous targets, shell panes and implicit broadcast
  remain refused.
- Ask Many compares explicit distinct panes rather than requiring different
  vendor kinds. Each answer remains independently attributed.
- Runtime readiness now needs one available agent CLI; a second pane can use
  either the same vendor or another vendor.

## Workspaces and folders

- Every workspace now has a stable **Workspace Home** and an independent
  **New Pane Folder**. Changing where future panes start does not change the
  workspace's folder-opening association or any running process.
- Several named task workspaces may intentionally share one home folder.
  Opening that folder focuses one match, presents a chooser for several, or
  creates a normal shell workspace when none exists.
- **Open New Workspace Here** deliberately creates another workspace without
  guessing or silently retargeting an existing one.
- Pane menus retain deterministic splits from New Pane Folder and add explicit
  **Split Right Here** and **Split Below Here** actions for the active pane's
  live working directory.
- Existing tmux workspaces receive the new home-folder metadata without
  restarting, respawning or changing their panes.

## Favourite folders and accessibility

- Favourite folders are bookmarks for quick workspace access. Adding one no
  longer changes the active workspace's New Pane Folder.
- Favourite rows distinguish active, open, multiply matched and unopened
  folders, with matching VoiceOver values and action-specific help.
- Canonical matching recognises aliases such as symlinked paths while retaining
  the path spelling chosen by the person for display.
- Workspace badges are more legible and use distinct symbols - not colour
  alone - for failed work and work needing human attention.
- Folder pickers, menus, Help and documentation now use consistent Workspace
  Home and New Pane Folder terminology.

## Upgrade notes

- Agent protocol v8 changes the instructions loaded into vendor CLIs. Existing
  panes with an older protocol remain usable as terminals but must be restarted
  once before agent-to-agent actions are enabled.
- Existing Production tmux sessions, layouts, favourites, context and
  collaboration history remain under
  `~/Library/Application Support/Parley Native`.

## Install and trust

- Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
- `tmux` and at least one supported, installed and signed-in vendor CLI.
- Download `Parley-0.1.7-mac-arm64.dmg`, quit Parley, replace `Parley.app` in
  Applications, and reopen it normally from Finder.
- This beta is ad-hoc signed and is **not notarized**. Use **System Settings >
  Privacy & Security > Open Anyway** only when the files came from this expected
  release. Never disable Gatekeeper globally.

Use `Parley-0.1.7-mac-arm64.SHA256SUMS` to verify every downloaded artifact.
